'''Bina''' is an extinct [[Austronesian languages|Austronesian]] language of [[Papua New Guinea]]. It was restructured through contact with neighboring [[Papuan languages]], and it turn influencing them, before speakers shifted to those languages.

==See also==
*[[Magori language]], a similar situation
